_comment: Optional per-trip overrides for the generated shelf at /trips/. Keyed by URL. Anything omitted falls back to the page's own trip-* meta tags, then its <title> and <meta name=description>. A page needs no entry here at all. Fields: label, title, blurb, order (lower sorts first), hidden (true keeps it off the shelf).
